description: This file defines the 'Signer' class in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for CloudFront. It provides methods to create signed URLs and cookies for CloudFront content, handling cryptographic signing with private keys.

classes.name: Signer
classes.description: A class for creating signed URLs and cookies for AWS CloudFront, using cryptographic signatures with private keys.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Signer with key pair ID, private key path, and optional passphrase; loads the private key for signing.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Frees the private key resource if PHP version is less than 8.

methods.name: getSignature
methods.description: Generates signature components for signed URLs or cookies, either using a policy or resource and expiration.

methods.name: createCannedPolicy
methods.description: Creates a JSON policy for CloudFront signed URLs with resource and expiration.

methods.name: sign
methods.description: Signs a policy string with the private key, returning the signature or throwing an exception on error.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a policy string in a URL-safe base64 format.
